title: Signal: Dart dependency declared as `any`
scope: A pubspec.yaml file that declares a pubspec dependency whose constraint is `any`.
limitations: It matches a pubspec dependency whose constraint is `any` in the parsed pubspec.yaml; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A pubspec.yaml that mentions a pubspec dependency whose constraint is `any` in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
